dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - August 08, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Braves Fall to Yankees in Thrilling Finish**

The New York Yankees edged out the Atlanta Braves 5-4 in a nail-biting contest, with Gerrit Cole dealing 7 scoreless innings, striking out 9 and walking none. George Lombard Jr. led the Braves' charge, blasting a solo homer and finishing with 2 hits and 1 RBI. Ronald Acuña Jr. and Ben Rice also contributed with notable performances, but it wasn't enough to overcome the Yankees' strong pitching.

**Athletics Rout Red Sox Behind Jump's Dominant Effort**

The Oakland Athletics cruised to a 7-3 victory over the Boston Red Sox, thanks in large part to Gage Jump's 6-inning, 11-strikeout performance. Tyler Soderstrom provided some power with a solo homer, while Henry Bolte and Jacob Wilson also chipped in with hits. The Red Sox struggled to contain the Athletics' offense, ultimately falling short.

**Marlins Shut Down Angels in Dominant Fashion**

The Miami Marlins dominated the Los Angeles Angels 7-0, with Sandy Alcantara tossing 7 scoreless innings and striking out 8. Xavier Edwards had a standout game with 2 hits and 3 RBIs, while Otto Lopez and Wade Meckler also contributed with hits. The Marlins' pitching staff was nearly flawless, holding the Angels to just 3 hits.

**Blue Jays Outlast Phillies in High-Scoring Affair**

The Toronto Blue Jays edged out the Philadelphia Phillies 7-5 in a back-and-forth contest. Nathan Lukes led the way with 3 hits, including a solo homer and 2 RBIs. Vladimir Guerrero Jr. and Ernie Clement also had notable performances, but it was Louis Varland who ultimately earned the win with 2 scoreless innings of relief.

**Pirates Rout Mets in One-Sided Affair**

The Pittsburgh Pirates pummeled the New York Mets 9-0, behind a strong team effort on the mound. Bubba Chandler tossed 6 scoreless innings and struck out 5, while Brandon Lowe hit a solo homer. The Pirates' offense was unstoppable, as they scored 9 runs on just 9 hits.

**Nationals Shut Down Reds in Dominant Fashion**

The Washington Nationals dominated the Cincinnati Reds 8-2, thanks in large part to Clayton Beeter's 6-inning, 7-strikeout performance. Eugenio Suárez hit a solo homer and finished with 1 hit and 2 RBIs. CJ Abrams also contributed with a hit and an RBI.

**Royals Outlast Cubs in Extra-Inning Thriller**

The Kansas City Royals edged out the Chicago Cubs 6-3 in 9 innings. Jac Caglianone hit 2 solo homers and finished with 4 hits and 4 RBIs. Seth Lugo earned the win with 2 scoreless innings of relief.
